question: Does the deployed availability-first flow resolve repeated provisional context labels from retrieved metadata and produce the UK60 neutron-star output through natural-speed voice and QA?
stop_conditions: Submit this ID once; never retry it.
Preserve ambiguous provider outcomes as terminal/unknown.
Stop at first factuality, source, relevance, quota, duration, alignment, render or machine-audit failure.
Keep natural-speed voice, photo relevance, exact duration and QA gates unchanged.
Stop media generation if /data free space falls below 100 MB.
This plan authorizes one request only.

actual.failure_boundary: independent material-brief fact review before any photo search
actual.failure: The single allowed draft correction changed supported material and introduced a universal claim about supernovae. Independent review rejected that qualifier; no further correction was allowed.

fix.description: Allow exactly one additional correction after independent semantic review rejects a claim, while preserving the one-correction cap for malformed drafts. Require corrections to retain source qualifiers and keep already accepted facts unchanged.
